editions.title: A clearer path through fictional payments
editions.summary: A fictional update about payment confirmation and settlement status.

sections.heading: Confirm the payment before it moves
sections.body: A fictional checkout now shows the amount and payment route before confirmation. The extra step gives a customer a clear moment to catch a mistaken selection.
lead_paragraphs: The fictional checkout makes the amount and route visible before confirmation.
why_it_matters: A readable confirmation can help prevent avoidable payment mistakes.

sections.heading: Make settlement status easier to follow
sections.body: In a made-up service, a transfer can remain pending while systems reconcile. A plain status note tells the customer what is known and when the next update is expected.
lead_paragraphs: A fictional transfer screen separates pending activity from a completed payment.
why_it_matters: Clear status reduces guesswork during a delay.
